correctness.rationale: The allowed ordered triples with >=2 nonzero symbols give a balanced strongly connected overlap digraph on q^2-1 nonzero ordered pairs, edge count (q-1)^2(q+2). Its degree pattern is q-1 on pairs containing one zero and q on fully nonzero pairs. The quotient on v_a,u_a and row sums R_a has q(q-2) eigenvalues q, 2(q-2) eigenvalues q-1, and three-dimensional constant block with characteristic polynomial x[x^2-(2q-1)x+q^2-1]; directed matrix-tree gives tau=q^{q(q-2)}(q-1)^{2(q-2)}. BEST factorials yield the exact formula with one distinguished triple fixing rotation, even for loops. An independent exact-integer graph builder gave tree counts 1,108,5308416 at q=2,3,4, exactly the formula. Finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.
